# dynaSpec: dynamic spectrogram visualizations

![sketchy sticker](reference/figures/dynaSpec_sticker.png)

**dynaSpec** creates dynamic spectrograms: spectrograms that move along
with the sound, ready for presentations, teaching or sharing online,
*without taking screen recordings* of another program. They are shown as
interactive web pages (with the sound embedded, click-to-play and
buttons to slow the sound down), which work in R Markdown and Quarto
documents, and can also be saved as videos (mp4). It builds on
[seewave](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=seewave) and
[tuneR](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=tuneR).

Dynamic spectrograms are built in layers, as ‘ggplot2’ graphs:
[`dynaspec()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/dynaspec.md)
takes the sound, and layers are added with `+` (only the panels added
are shown):

| Layer | What it does |
|----|----|
| [`ds_spectrogram()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/ds_spectrogram.md) | Adds a spectrogram (window length, palette, amplitude range, …) |
| [`ds_oscillogram()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/ds_oscillogram.md), [`ds_envelope()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/ds_envelope.md) | Add an oscillogram or an amplitude envelope (above or below the spectrogram) |
| [`ds_spectrum()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/ds_spectrum.md) | Adds a power spectrum next to the spectrogram |
| [`ds_overview()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/ds_overview.md) | Adds a lower panel with the whole sound to scrolling spectrograms |
| [`ds_annotations()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/ds_annotations.md) | Highlights parts of the sound with translucent boxes, borders and labels (e.g. from a selection table) |
| [`ds_captions()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/ds_captions.md) | Text at a fixed position shown during a time range, like subtitles |
| [`ds_theme()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/ds_theme.md), [`ds_theme_dark()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/ds_theme.md), … | Axis titles, fonts, colors of the figure and plot, and preset themes |
| [`ds_player()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/ds_player.md) | Playback controls of web pages (speed slider, loop, volume, download, …) |
| [`ds_static()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/styles.md), [`ds_scrolling()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/styles.md) or [`ds_paged()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/styles.md) | Style of the dynamic spectrogram (see below) |

The package offers three styles of dynamic spectrogram:

| Style | What it looks like |
|----|----|
| Static ([`ds_static()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/styles.md), default) | A play line moves over the whole spectrogram (and oscillogram), which can be split in several rows |
| Scrolling ([`ds_scrolling()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/styles.md)) | The spectrogram scrolls from right to left past a fixed “play” line, as in the Macaulay Library |
| Paged ([`ds_paged()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/styles.md)) | A spectrogram (or several “pages”) revealed by a sliding highlight box, as in Adobe Audition’s spectral view |

### What it looks like

The previews below are silent animations made from videos saved with
[`save_dynaspec()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/save_dynaspec.md)
(in R, printing the objects shows interactive web pages with sound).

**Static spectrogram** with an oscillogram, annotation lines and the
‘mako’ theme:

``` r

st <- data.frame(start = c(0.34, 1.13, 1.75, 2.34), end = c(1.03, 1.68, 2.33, 2.55),
                 labels = c("long note", "arched notes", "trill", "end note"), y = c(4.6, 4.9, 5.4, 4))

dynaspec(scythebill, flim = c(1.5, Inf)) +
  ds_spectrogram(wl = 200, collevels = seq(-50, 0, 1)) +
  ds_oscillogram() +
  ds_annotations(st, type = "line", line.freq = "y", labels = "labels") +
  ds_theme_mako()
```

![Static spectrogram of a brown-billed scythebill song with an
oscillogram and labeled lines above the notes, with a play line moving
across](reference/figures/readme_static.gif)

**Scrolling spectrogram** with an overview of the whole sound and the
Macaulay Library look:

``` r

dynaspec(antshrike, flim = c(0.5, 5.5), tlim = c(0.1, 5)) +
  ds_spectrogram(wl = 256, collevels = seq(-50, 0, 1)) +
  ds_overview() +
  ds_theme_macaulay() +
  ds_scrolling(t.display = 2, fix.time = FALSE)
```

![Scrolling spectrogram of a great antshrike song passing a fixed play
line, with an overview of the whole sound
below](reference/figures/readme_scrolling.gif)

**Paged spectrogram**, revealed by a sliding highlight box:

``` r

dynaspec(antshrike, flim = c(0.5, 5.5), tlim = c(0.1, 5)) +
  ds_spectrogram(wl = 256, collevels = seq(-50, 0, 1)) +
  ds_paged(t.display = 2.5)
```

![Paged spectrogram of a great antshrike song revealed by a sliding
highlight box](reference/figures/readme_paged.gif)

**Vignette and articles** (on the [package
website](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/)):

- [Creating dynamic
  spectrograms](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/articles/dynaSpec.html)
  (vignette; also
  [`vignette("dynaSpec")`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/articles/dynaSpec.md)
  in R): basic usage of every layer and of the three styles, and how to
  save and embed them
- [Themes for dynamic
  spectrograms](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/articles/themes.html):
  theme settings and preset themes, including looks inspired by the
  Xeno-canto and Macaulay Library players
- [Customizing dynamic
  spectrograms](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/articles/customizing.html):
  spectrograms, panels, styles, annotations, captions, player controls
  and videos

## Installation

Install latest version from CRAN:

``` r

install.packages("dynaSpec")
```

Or install the development version from GitHub (requires
[remotes](https://cran.r-project.org/package=remotes)):

``` r

remotes::install_github("maRce10/dynaSpec")
```

### ffmpeg

Web pages do not need any external software. However, to create videos
dynaSpec uses [ffmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org/download.html), which must be
installed and available in the system path:

| Operating system | Command (in a terminal) |
|----|----|
| Windows | `winget install --id Gyan.FFmpeg -e` (or download a build from [gyan.dev](https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/) and add its `bin` folder to the PATH) |
| macOS | `brew install ffmpeg` |
| Debian/Ubuntu | `sudo apt install ffmpeg` |

You can check that R finds it with:

``` r

Sys.which("ffmpeg")
```

If ffmpeg is installed somewhere else, point R to the executable with
`Sys.setenv(ffmpeg = "path/to/ffmpeg")`.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`antshrike`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/antshrike.md)
  :

  Acoustic recording of *Taraba major* (great antshrike) songs

- [`female_barn_swallow`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/barn_swallow.md)
  [`male_barn_swallow`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/barn_swallow.md)
  :

  Acoustic recordings of *Hirundo rustica* (barn swallow) songs

- [`ds_annotations()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/ds_annotations.md)
  : Annotation layer of dynamic spectrograms

- [`ds_captions()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/ds_captions.md)
  : Caption layer of dynamic spectrograms

- [`ds_envelope()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/ds_envelope.md)
  : Amplitude envelope layer of dynamic spectrograms

- [`ds_oscillogram()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/ds_oscillogram.md)
  : Oscillogram layer of dynamic spectrograms

- [`ds_overview()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/ds_overview.md)
  : Overview layer of scrolling spectrograms

- [`ds_player()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/ds_player.md)
  : Player settings of dynamic spectrogram web pages

- [`ds_set_theme()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/ds_set_theme.md)
  [`ds_get_theme()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/ds_set_theme.md)
  : Set the theme of all dynamic spectrograms

- [`ds_spectrogram()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/ds_spectrogram.md)
  : Spectrogram layer of dynamic spectrograms

- [`ds_spectrum()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/ds_spectrum.md)
  : Power spectrum layer of dynamic spectrograms

- [`ds_theme()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/ds_theme.md)
  [`ds_theme_dark()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/ds_theme.md)
  [`ds_theme_presentation()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/ds_theme.md)
  [`ds_theme_paper()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/ds_theme.md)
  [`ds_theme_minimal()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/ds_theme.md)
  [`ds_theme_transparent()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/ds_theme.md)
  [`ds_theme_void()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/ds_theme.md)
  [`ds_theme_macaulay()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/ds_theme.md)
  [`ds_theme_xenocanto()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/ds_theme.md)
  [`ds_theme_mako()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/ds_theme.md)
  : Theme of dynamic spectrograms

- [`dynaspec()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/dynaspec.md)
  : Create dynamic spectrograms

- [`` `+`( ``*`<dynaspec>`*`)`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/plus-.dynaspec.md)
  : Add layers to dynamic spectrograms

- [`save_dynaspec()`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/save_dynaspec.md)
  : Save dynamic spectrograms

- [`scythebill`](https://marce10.github.io/dynaSpec/reference/scythebill.md)
  :

  Acoustic recording of a *Campylorhamphus pusillus* (brown-billed
  scythebill) song
